apps.name: Server Manager
apps.description: Monitor and control system services — start, stop, restart, and check status of web servers, databases, and more. Configure PHP, MySQL, Nginx, SSH and UFW firewall settings directly from the UI.

apps.name: Process Manager
apps.description: Monitor CPU, memory and disk usage. View and manage running processes.

apps.name: System Info
apps.description: Detailed hardware and system information — CPU, memory, disks, network interfaces, temperatures, uptime and more.

apps.name: Server Monitor
apps.description: Real-time server metrics with history. Tracks CPU, RAM, disk, network every minute.

apps.name: State Tracker
apps.description: Track state changes of anything over time — ping, HTTP checks, API values, or manual push.
